This '''Jedi''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He trained alongside [[Jedi Master|Masters]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and [[Kirlocca]] at the [[Almas Academy]].
